situation: Buyer Co. is considering a 3-year subscription to the DocStream AI document-processing platform from Supplier Co. The common deal terms are in deal_terms and Supplier Co.'s current offer is in supplier_offer; world shows the negotiation table. Evaluation reports from your colleagues that are available to you are included in the information below.
authority: You decide Buyer Co.'s official move now. accept: buy at Supplier Co.'s offered price (price must equal world.offers.seller). offer: make a counter-offer at a price you choose. walk_away: end the talks.
reply: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"side": "buyer", "move": "accept" or "offer" or "walk_away", "price": <integer USD>}. For walk_away use price 0.
